groups.title: Do
items: Use helper text for expected format.
Use Field Action only for actions that operate on the current field value.

groups.title: Do not
items: Do not use placeholder as the only label.
Do not clear input on error.
Do not hide disabled or loading reason.
Do not place an autonomous Icon Button inside the field surface.

groups.title: Escalate
items: Use a pattern for suggestions, masks, or multi-field flows.
Ask before adding product-specific parsing or a new Field Action behavior.
